findings.issue: The rework dropped the 'before you joined' framing that made the fries story fit level_03. 'last time mina got a plate of fries while i had a double stack. this time she gets a burger' nearly copies Liam's level_03 lines ('last time you ate a plate of fries while i had a double stack... this time you get a real burger too'). In level_03 the patrol worked and Mina got a veggie patty, so the most recent burger night with them was not the fries night. A returning player reads this as if level_03 never happened. (The clutter audit's own merge wording used 'last time', so the problem started there.)
findings.rule: Critic brief check 7 (Continuity: no contradictions with earlier levels); narrative-writer brief, Continuity ('last time' references must match earlier levels)
findings.suggested_fix: Replace script[14] text with: "burger night means i'm on fries patrol. roxy, one burger night before you joined, mina got a plate of fries while i had a double stack. so tonight she gets a burger with zero meat in it". Keep clue diet:vegetarian, callback plate_of_fries and emotion NEUTRAL. No outcome line needs to change.

findings.issue: Roxy 'bought a bike on monday', but in level_11 she found the Night Market by biking home a different way, so she already had a bike. It's a small wobble, but a returning player may catch it.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace script[7] text with: "got a new bike on monday and rode it straight into a hedge. the hedge is fine". The rest of the line stays as it is.

summary: The rework fixes what the audit found. The middle of the chat is now real conversation: Mina's 'how's everyone's week' gets four answers (trumpet neighbour, hedge, spice rack, laundromat quarters), Maya's budget comes out of her week in one line that covers both price traps, and the six-line fries cluster and both agreement echoes are gone. Every need is findable in the implied style, and every trap is backed by its review: Roxy names Hollow Oak's peanut sauce and crushed peanuts; 'zero meat in it' covers Velvet Tent; 'a little over... fancy prices' covers Midnight Orchard and Crooked Pine; Mina's 'buttered buns and melted cheese' covers Bun Stop; Amber Lamp's reviews give peanut-free, meatless and butter- and cheese-free evidence. Mina carrying Roxy's dairy clue fits clue rule 6 (a friend hints it), and it's in voice: she turns the attention away from herself. There's no work-win hint, which stays in level_14, and the outcomes match the new chat and the reviews (Roxy's 'this is the one i crossed off', 'the patrol caught the cheese'). One must-fix: the fries callback lost its 'before you joined' framing and now contradicts level_03. It's a one-line fix.
